root.label: Queensland government IT systems audit reported

events.label: Queensland government IT systems audit reported

slots.name: audited systems
slots.sentence: A 2025 Queensland government audit of IT systems found more than half of the 57 systems audited are at the end of life.

slots.name: IT investment
slots.sentence: The Queensland government in the 2025 budget allocated $1bn over four years for IT investment, including replacing or updating legacy systems.

slots.name: legacy system age
slots.sentence: Many of the systems identified by the government in 2012 as needing to be replaced were still in operation in 2025, including a patient administration system at Queensland Health, a forensic register at the Queensland Police Service, and a trust accounts system for young people in detention.
